definitions.ask: Which mark should the Birthdays calendar wear?
definitions.why: 🎂 is the most legible birthday glyph at the start of a row

choices.label: 🎂 reads as a birthday at a glance and echoes Google's own birthday art
🎁 hints at a gift to buy, but reads less plainly as a birthday
🥳 is festive, but reads as any celebration, not only a birthday

definitions.ask: Add a decisions record saying every non-primary calendar's rows wear its configured mark?
